:root {
  --bg: #080c12;
  --surface-1: rgba(16, 22, 31, .78);
  --surface-2: rgba(22, 29, 39, .84);
  --border: rgba(255,255,255,.105);
  --text: #eee9df;

  --muted-2: rgba(238,233,223,.46);
  --rubric: #b85b58;
  --liturgical: #4f8f66;
  --liturgical-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--liturgical) 17%, transparent);
  --liturgical-border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--liturgical) 45%, rgba(255,255,255,.11));
  --liturgical-glow: color-mix(in srgb, var(--liturgical) 25%, transparent);
  --font-liturgical: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  --font-display: 'Cinzel', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  --safe-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
  --safe-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
  --radius-s: 10px;
  --radius-m: 16px;
  --radius-l: 22px;
  --shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
}

body {
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 18%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--liturgical) 10%, transparent), transparent 34rem),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #0d121a 0%, #080b10 68%, #06080c 100%);
  transition: --liturgical .85s ease;
}
.homeScreen {
  width: min(100%, 680px);
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: calc(14px + var(--safe-top)) 16px calc(28px + var(--safe-bottom));
}
.homeHeader { position: relative; }
.brandRow { min-height: 48px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.brandMark { width: 42px; height: 42px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1px solid var(--liturgical-border); border-radius:14px; background:var(--liturgical-soft); color:var(--liturgical); font:700 .72rem/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing:.08em; }
.brandName { color: var(--liturgical); font: 700 .82rem/1.1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: .14em; }
.brandSub { color: var(--muted-2); font-size:.76rem; margin-top:4px; }
.languageSwitch { display:flex; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:999px; padding:2px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.025); }
.languageSwitch button { min-width:34px; min-height:32px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted-2); font:600 .68rem/1 system-ui,sans-serif; }
.languageSwitch button.active { color:var(--text); background:var(--liturgical-soft); }
.dateNavigator { display:grid; grid-template-columns:44px 1fr 44px; align-items:center; margin:14px 0 10px; }
.iconButton, .dateTitle { border:0; background:transparent; color:inherit; min-height:44px; }
.iconButton { font-size:1.7rem; color:var(--muted); }
.dateTitle { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:1px; }
.dateTitle span { color:var(--muted); text-transform:capitalize; font-size:.82rem; }
.dateTitle b { font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600; font-size:.78rem; letter-spacing:.04em; }
.dateRail { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr); gap:5px; padding:6px; border:1px solid var(--border); background:rgba(255,255,255,.025); border-radius:16px; }
.dayCell { min-height:52px; border:0; border-radius:11px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:3px; }
.dayCell span { font:600 .62rem/1 system-ui,sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; }
.dayCell b { font-size:.95rem; font-weight:600; }
.dayCell.today:not(.selected) b::after { content:''; display:block; width:3px; height:3px; margin:2px auto -5px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--liturgical); }
.dayCell.selected { color:var(--text); background:var(--liturgical-soft); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--liturgical-border); }
.celebrationBlock { text-align:center; padding:24px 4px 18px; }
.eyebrow, .sectionLabel, .cardKicker { color:var(--liturgical); font:600 .68rem/1.2 var(--font-display); letter-spacing:.11em; text-transform:uppercase; }
.celebrationBlock h1 { margin:9px auto 8px; max-width:560px; font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:clamp(1.45rem,7vw,2.2rem); line-height:1.12; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.018em; text-wrap:balance; }
.metaLine { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; gap:5px 12px; color:var(--muted); font-size:.82rem; }
.loadingLine { margin-top:12px; display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:7px; align-items:center; color:var(--muted-2); font-size:.78rem; }
.loadingLine span { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--liturgical); box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--liturgical); animation:pulse 1.1s infinite alternate; }
@keyframes pulse { to { opacity:.35; } }
.statusCard { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; padding:12px 14px; margin:0 0 15px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.035); }
.statusCard strong { font-size:.86rem; }.statusCard span { color:var(--muted); font-size:.8rem; line-height:1.35; }
.statusCard.warning { border-color:var(--liturgical-border); }.statusCard.error { border-color:rgba(184,91,88,.38); }
.homeSection { margin:2px 0 18px; }
.sectionLabel { margin:0 0 9px 3px; color:var(--muted-2); }
.phaseActions { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1.14fr 1fr; gap:8px; }
.phaseButton { min-height:72px; border-radius:16px; border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--surface-1); color:var(--text); display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.12); }
.phaseButton span { color:var(--muted-2); font:600 .64rem/1 var(--font-display); }.phaseButton b { font-size:.9rem; font-weight:600; }
.phaseButton.primary { border-color:var(--liturgical-border); background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--liturgical-soft),rgba(255,255,255,.035)); box-shadow:0 12px 35px var(--liturgical-glow); }
.phaseButton.primary b { color:var(--liturgical); }
.contentCard { margin:0 0 11px; padding:17px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius-m); background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.045),rgba(255,255,255,.025)); box-shadow:0 12px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.14); }
.gospelCard { border-color:var(--liturgical-border); }
.scriptureRef { margin-top:6px; color:var(--text); font-size:.87rem; font-weight:600; }
.contentCard p { margin:9px 0 0; color:var(--muted); font-size:1rem; line-height:1.48; }
.textAction { border:0; padding:11px 0 0; background:transparent; color:var(--liturgical); font-weight:600; font-size:.88rem; }
.textAction span { margin-left:5px; }
.massCard,.moreCard { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 46px; align-items:center; gap:14px; }
.massCard p,.moreCard p { font-size:.88rem; margin-top:5px; }
.roundAction { width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid var(--border); background:rgba(255,255,255,.04); color:var(--text); font-size:1.05rem; }
.massCard .roundAction { border-color:var(--liturgical-border); color:var(--liturgical); background:var(--liturgical-soft); }
.moreCard { opacity:.88; }.homeSpacer{height:4px}.alphaNotice { position:sticky; bottom:calc(8px + var(--safe-bottom)); margin:8px auto 0; max-width:440px; padding:9px 12px; border-radius:12px; background:rgba(7,10,14,.94); border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--muted); text-align:center; font-size:.76rem; }
@media (min-width:700px) { .homeScreen { padding-left:24px; padding-right:24px; } }
@media (max-width:350px) { .homeScreen{padding-left:10px;padding-right:10px}.brandSub{display:none}.phaseButton b{font-size:.78rem}.contentCard{padding:14px}.dateRail{gap:2px;padding:4px}.dayCell{min-height:48px}.celebrationBlock{padding-top:18px}.celebrationBlock h1{font-size:1.35rem}.metaLine{font-size:.75rem} }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { body { transition:none; } .loadingLine span{animation:none;} }

<!-- v24 unified devotional/prayer layer -->
<style id="ao-labora-ui-port-css">
/* Direct Lab-ora UI/UX port for the Ad Orientem traditional prayer layer. */
#aoPrayerBookRoot{
 --night:#07192c;--deep:#0b2540;--panel:#102f4c;--line:#34516b;--silver:#c5d1da;
 --paper:#f1eee5;--ink:#10263a;--gold:#c7ae6d;--muted:#95a9b9;
 --serif:"EB Garamond",Georgia,serif;--display:"Cinzel",serif;
 background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% -20%,#193b5b 0,var(--night) 48%,#04101e 100%);
 color:var(--paper);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:17px
}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .pbShell{max-width:920px;padding:0 18px 92px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-view-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:14px;margin:0 0 18px;padding-top:24px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-view-head>div:nth-child(2){flex:1}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-back,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-icon{border:0;background:none;color:var(--silver);padding:10px;border-radius:9px;min-width:42px;min-height:42px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-back:hover,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-icon:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-view-head h1{font:600 clamp(1.75rem,7vw,2.8rem)/1.05 var(--serif);margin:0}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-view-head .eyebrow{font:500 .69rem var(--display);color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 5px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-lang{color:var(--gold);font:600 .68rem var(--display);letter-spacing:.1em}

/* Lab-ora Phase-F prayer library */
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-root{display:grid;gap:18px;max-width:900px;margin-inline:auto}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-section{padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(16,47,76,.72)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:10px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-head p,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-head h2{margin:0}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-head h2{margin-top:2px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-grid button{min-height:76px;padding:13px;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);color:var(--paper)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-grid button.featured{border-color:var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(145deg,#173b5a,#0b2540)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-grid strong,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-grid span{display:block}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-grid span{color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px;line-height:1.2;font-size:.88rem}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-search{width:100%;min-height:44px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--deep);color:var(--paper);padding:9px 11px;font:inherit;margin-bottom:10px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-source-note{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.45;margin:10px 0 0}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-source-note a{color:var(--gold)}

/* Shared Lab-ora formation / paper surfaces */
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-lead{max-width:760px;color:var(--silver);font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.5;margin:-4px 0 18px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:14px 0 22px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-grid button{min-height:108px;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:rgba(16,47,76,.72);color:var(--paper);text-align:left}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-grid button strong{display:block;font-size:1.18rem;margin-bottom:3px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-grid button span{display:block;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.25}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-grid .primary-practice{border-color:var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(145deg,#173b5a,#0b2540)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-sheet,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-sheet{padding:clamp(20px,5vw,34px);border-radius:20px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.3);margin-bottom:14px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-sheet h2,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-sheet h3{color:var(--ink)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-sheet p,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-sheet li{line-height:1.5}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-sheet details{border-top:1px solid #cfd6d9;padding:12px 0}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-sheet summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-status{display:inline-block;font:500 .62rem var(--display);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#5b4721;background:#efe2bd;border:1px solid #d9c17f;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 7px;margin:0 4px 5px 0}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-status.custom{background:#e7dfd1;border-color:#c7ad7c}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-status.official{background:#dbe7de;border-color:#aac1b0;color:#31533a}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-note{padding:13px 15px;border-left:3px solid var(--gold);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;color:var(--silver);line-height:1.45;margin:12px 0}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-sheet .lab-practice-note{background:#e7ebed;color:#334d60;border-left-color:#9e7e35}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:13px 0}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-actions button{border:1px solid #b7c2c9;border-radius:10px;background:#eef1f1;color:var(--ink);padding:10px 12px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-actions .accent{background:var(--deep);color:var(--paper);border-color:var(--deep)}

/* Latin-first flip on a Lab-ora paper card */
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-flip{display:block;width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);padding:0;font:400 clamp(1.08rem,3vw,1.28rem)/1.62 var(--serif);text-align:left;white-space:pre-wrap;cursor:pointer}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-flip-hint{margin:12px 0 0;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #cfd6d9;color:#6b7480;font:600 .68rem var(--display);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-reader-meta{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-reader-meta span{font:600 .62rem var(--display);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6b5225;background:#efe2bd;border:1px solid #d9c17f;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 7px}

/* Rosary flagship UI copied from Lab-ora */
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-rosary-hero{padding:18px;border:1px solid rgba(197,209,218,.2);border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(18,53,82,.88),rgba(6,22,38,.9));margin-bottom:14px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-rosary-hero small{display:block;font:600 .65rem var(--display);letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:5px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-rosary-hero strong{display:block;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,5vw,2.35rem);line-height:1.05}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-rosary-hero p{color:var(--silver);line-height:1.35;margin:8px 0 14px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-rosary-hero button{min-height:46px;border-radius:11px;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:var(--gold);color:#18212a;font-weight:700}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-mystery-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-mystery-card{min-height:160px;padding:15px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;background:rgba(16,47,76,.65);color:var(--paper);text-align:left;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-mystery-card.recommended{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(199,174,109,.35)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-mystery-card small{display:block;color:var(--gold);font:600 .62rem var(--display);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:5px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-mystery-card strong{display:block;font-size:1.35rem}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-mystery-card ol{margin:9px 0 0 18px;padding:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.35}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-option-bar{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0 17px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-option-bar label{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 10px;color:var(--silver);font-size:.86rem}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-option-bar input{accent-color:var(--gold)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-decade-bar{display:flex;gap:5px;margin:0 0 12px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-decade-bar i{height:4px;flex:1;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.13)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-decade-bar i.done,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-decade-bar i.current{background:var(--gold)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-bead-stage{min-height:58px;margin:2px 0 10px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-bead{width:25px;height:25px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #9fb0bd;background:#15344d;color:#172532;padding:0}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-bead.past{background:#806f49;border-color:#c0aa6c}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-bead.current{width:31px;height:31px;background:var(--gold);border-color:#f0d486;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(199,174,109,.14),0 0 12px rgba(199,174,109,.38)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-step-count{color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;font-size:.82rem}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-sheet{text-align:left}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-sheet>.rubric{text-align:center;color:#6b5225;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:8px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-sheet>h2{text-align:center;font-size:1.55rem;color:var(--ink);margin-top:0}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-count{text-align:center;color:#687581;margin:0 0 14px;font:600 .72rem var(--display);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-count strong{color:#806626;font-size:1.18rem}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-scripture-cue{max-width:650px;margin:0 auto 17px;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:12px;background:#e5e0d5;color:#334d60;line-height:1.45}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-scripture-cue strong{display:block;color:#806626;font:700 .64rem var(--display);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:4px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-player-controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-player-controls button{min-height:50px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--paper)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-player-controls .primary{background:var(--silver);color:var(--ink);border-color:#e1e8ed;font-family:var(--display);font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.07em}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-contemplation{padding:20px;border-radius:19px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 16px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.24)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-contemplation .kicker{font:700 .63rem var(--display);letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#806626}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-contemplation h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,6vw,2.45rem);line-height:1.04;margin:6px 0 12px;color:var(--ink)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-contemplation .principal{margin:13px 0;padding:14px;border-left:3px solid #a7853b;background:#e8e3d8;line-height:1.45}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-contemplation .fruit{font-weight:600;color:#6b5225;margin:10px 0}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-contemplation .commentary{line-height:1.55}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-contemplation a{color:#305f83}

/* Stations copied from the Lab-ora v24 visual model */
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-hero{padding:20px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(20,57,88,.94),rgba(8,29,49,.98));margin-bottom:14px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-hero strong{display:block;font-size:1.55rem}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-hero p{color:var(--silver);line-height:1.4;margin:7px 0 14px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-settings{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:14px 0}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-settings button,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-settings label{min-height:44px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#0f2b45;color:var(--paper);padding:9px 11px;text-align:left}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-settings button.active{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(199,174,109,.35)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-settings .wide{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-settings input{accent-color:var(--gold)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-station-rail{display:flex;gap:5px;overflow-x:auto;padding:4px 0 12px;scrollbar-width:none}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-station-rail i{min-width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #60798d;color:#9fb0bd;font-style:normal;font-size:.72rem}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-station-rail i.done{background:#806f49;border-color:#c0aa6c;color:#f4dfaa}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-station-rail i.current{background:var(--gold);border-color:#efd27e;color:#172532}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-station-text h3{color:#6b5225;margin:20px 0 5px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stabat{margin-top:18px;padding-top:15px;border-top:1px solid #cfd6d9}

#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-progress{height:8px;background:#07192c;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin:0 0 14px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-progress i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--gold);transition:width .2s}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-source-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-source-row a{color:#305f83;font-size:.9rem}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-change{border:0;background:none;color:var(--gold);padding:10px 0;margin-top:5px}

@media(max-width:650px){
 #aoPrayerBookRoot .pbShell{padding-left:13px;padding-right:13px}
 #aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-library-grid,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-grid,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-mystery-grid,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-settings{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 #aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-settings .wide{grid-column:auto}
 #aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-mystery-card{min-height:138px}
}

#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-sheet .lab-source-note,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-sheet .lab-source-note{color:#526879}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-prayer-sheet .lab-source-note a,#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-practice-sheet .lab-source-note a{color:#305f83}

</style>
<style id="ao-rosary-depth-recitation-css">

.ao-r-depth-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:11000;display:none;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;background:rgba(4,13,23,.68);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);padding:18px}
.ao-r-depth-modal.open{display:flex}.ao-r-depth-panel{width:min(780px,100%);max-height:min(90vh,920px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#f8f7f1;color:#172532;border:1px solid rgba(133,111,58,.28);border-radius:20px 20px 12px 12px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.38)}
.ao-r-depth-panel>header{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:17px 18px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(100,100,100,.14);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(185,154,80,.08),transparent)}
.ao-r-depth-panel>header>div{flex:1;min-width:0}.ao-r-depth-panel header small{display:block;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#7c6b43;font-size:.66rem;margin-bottom:4px}.ao-r-depth-panel header h2{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-liturgical,Georgia,serif);font-size:1.35rem}.ao-r-depth-panel header p{margin:5px 0 0;color:#66737d;font-size:.82rem}
.ao-r-depth-panel header button{border:0;background:transparent;font-size:1.55rem;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;color:inherit}.ao-r-depth-scroll{overflow:auto;padding:15px 18px 18px}.ao-r-depth-panel>footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 18px 13px;border-top:1px solid rgba(100,100,100,.14);background:rgba(255,255,255,.4);color:#697984;font-size:.72rem}
.ao-r-depth-panel>footer button{border:1px solid rgba(117,91,28,.32);border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:#6f571e;padding:7px 11px;font-weight:700}.ao-r-loading,.ao-r-error{padding:28px 8px;text-align:center;color:#66737d}.ao-r-error strong{display:block;color:#172532;margin-bottom:6px}
.ao-r-verses{font-family:var(--font-liturgical,Georgia,serif);font-size:1.01rem;line-height:1.67}.ao-r-verses p{position:relative;margin:0;padding:7px 8px 7px 38px;border-radius:8px}.ao-r-verses p>span{position:absolute;left:9px;top:9px;width:20px;text-align:right;color:#8a7850;font:700 .68rem var(--sans)}.ao-r-verses p.current{background:rgba(185,154,80,.14);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #b99a50}
.ao-r-commentary{margin:0 0 16px;padding:13px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(100,100,100,.14);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}.ao-r-commentary h3{margin:0 0 8px;color:#6f571e;font-family:var(--font-liturgical,Georgia,serif);font-size:1rem}.ao-r-commentary blockquote{margin:0 0 12px;padding:10px 12px;border-left:3px solid rgba(185,154,80,.55);background:rgba(185,154,80,.06);font-style:italic}.ao-r-commentary details{border-top:1px solid rgba(100,100,100,.10);padding:8px 0}.ao-r-commentary details:first-of-type{border-top:0}.ao-r-commentary summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;color:#755b1c}.ao-r-commentary p{white-space:pre-line;line-height:1.62}.ao-r-commentary a{color:#755b1c}.ao-r-lang-note{padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(117,91,28,.18);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(185,154,80,.07);font-size:.78rem;color:#66737d}
body.ao-r-depth-open{overflow:hidden}
@media(max-width:650px){#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-recitation-mode small{width:100%;margin-left:0}.ao-r-depth-modal{padding:0;align-items:stretch}.ao-r-depth-panel{width:100%;height:100%;max-height:none;border-radius:0;border:0}.ao-r-depth-scroll{padding:12px 12px 18px}}
</style>
<style id="ao-traditional-prayerbook-css">

#aoPrayerBookRoot.open{display:block}.pbShell{min-height:100%;max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px 80px}.pbTop{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:8;display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:15px 0 13px;background:linear-gradient(var(--bg,#0d1218) 78%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.pbTop button,.pbIconButton{border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(255,255,255,.14));background:var(--surface,#151c24);color:inherit;border-radius:12px;min-height:42px;padding:8px 12px}.pbTop small{display:block;color:var(--muted,#9ba1aa);font:600 .63rem/1.2 var(--font-display,system-ui);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}.pbTop h1{margin:2px 0 0;font:600 clamp(1.15rem,4vw,1.6rem)/1.15 var(--font-display,Georgia,serif)}.pbLangBadge{color:var(--liturgical,#d8bd7d);font:700 .68rem var(--font-display,system-ui);letter-spacing:.1em}
.pbHero{padding:18px;border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(255,255,255,.12));border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.045),rgba(255,255,255,.015));margin:8px 0 16px}.pbHero .eyebrow,.pbKicker{color:var(--liturgical,#d8bd7d);font:700 .65rem var(--font-display,system-ui);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}.pbHero h2{font-size:clamp(1.35rem,4vw,2rem);margin:5px 0 7px}.pbHero p,.pbLead{color:var(--muted,#aeb2b8);line-height:1.55;margin:0}
.pbSearch{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(255,255,255,.14));border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface,#151c24);color:inherit;padding:13px 15px;font:inherit;margin:0 0 16px}.pbModuleGrid,.pbPrayerGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.pbModule,.pbPrayerCard,.pbActionCard{border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(255,255,255,.13));border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface,#151c24);color:inherit;text-align:left;padding:15px;min-height:92px}.pbModule strong,.pbPrayerCard strong,.pbActionCard strong{display:block;font:600 1.02rem var(--font-display,Georgia,serif);color:var(--text,#f3ead7)}.pbModule span,.pbPrayerCard span,.pbActionCard span{display:block;color:var(--muted,#a4aab1);font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.35;margin-top:5px}.pbModule.featured{border-color:var(--liturgical-border,rgba(216,189,125,.45));background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(216,189,125,.09),rgba(255,255,255,.015))}.pbSection{margin:24px 0}.pbSectionHead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}.pbSectionHead h2{margin:0;font-size:1.12rem}.pbSectionHead small{color:var(--muted,#999)}
.pbReader{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}.pbMeta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:8px 0 14px}.pbTag{border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(255,255,255,.13));border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px;color:var(--muted,#aeb2b8);font:600 .66rem var(--font-display,system-ui);letter-spacing:.06em}.pbPrayerText{display:block;width:100%;border:1px solid var(--liturgical-border,rgba(216,189,125,.38));border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);color:var(--text,#f3ead7);padding:clamp(18px,4vw,30px);font:400 clamp(1.08rem,3vw,1.34rem)/1.72 var(--font-liturgical,Georgia,serif);text-align:left;white-space:pre-wrap;cursor:pointer}.pbPrayerText[data-face="vernacular"]{background:rgba(216,189,125,.06)}.pbFlipHint{margin:9px 4px 0;color:var(--muted,#969da5);font-size:.76rem}.pbSource{margin-top:18px;padding:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border,rgba(255,255,255,.12));color:var(--muted,#aab0b7);font-size:.83rem;line-height:1.45}.pbSource a{color:var(--liturgical,#d8bd7d)}
.pbFlow{max-width:780px;margin:0 auto}.pbProgress{height:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin:3px 0 18px}.pbProgress span{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--liturgical,#d8bd7d)}.pbFlowCard{border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(255,255,255,.13));border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface,#151c24);padding:18px}.pbFlowCard h2{margin:5px 0 10px;font-size:1.35rem}.pbFlowCard p,.pbFlowCard li{line-height:1.55;color:var(--muted,#b0b5bb)}.pbFlowNav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}.pbFlowNav button,.pbPrimary,.pbSecondary{border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(255,255,255,.13));border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#151c24);color:inherit;min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px}.pbPrimary{background:var(--liturgical,#cbaa61);color:#17130d;border-color:transparent;font-weight:700}.pbChoiceRow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:14px 0}.pbChoiceRow button{border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(255,255,255,.13));border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:inherit;padding:9px 12px}.pbChoiceRow button.active{border-color:var(--liturgical,#d8bd7d);color:var(--liturgical,#d8bd7d)}
.pbExam details,.pbInfoDetails{border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(255,255,255,.11));border-radius:13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.018);margin:8px 0;padding:0 13px}.pbExam summary,.pbInfoDetails summary{cursor:pointer;padding:12px 0;font-weight:600}.pbExam ul{margin:0 0 13px;padding-left:20px}.pbMiniPrayer{margin:10px 0}.pbMiniPrayer .pbPrayerText{font-size:1rem;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:13px}.pbMysteryTitle{font:600 1.3rem var(--font-display,Georgia,serif);margin:6px 0}.pbCounter{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0}.pbCounter i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--liturgical-border,rgba(216,189,125,.5));display:block}.pbContextNotice{border-left:3px solid var(--liturgical,#d8bd7d);padding:11px 13px;background:rgba(216,189,125,.07);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;margin:12px 0;color:var(--muted,#b2b7bd)}
.pbNoResults{padding:25px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted,#999)}
@media(max-width:650px){.pbModuleGrid,.pbPrayerGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.pbShell{padding-left:13px;padding-right:13px}.pbTop{grid-template-columns:42px 1fr auto}.pbPrayerText{line-height:1.62}.pbModule,.pbPrayerCard{min-height:76px}}
</style>

<style id="ao-unified-rc2-module-ux-css">
/* Unified RC2 — common module controls, guide sheets and preferences */
.rc2ModuleTools{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin:-5px 0 16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rc2ModuleTools button,.rc2FlowPrefs{min-height:38px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(197,209,218,.24);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(16,47,76,.66);color:var(--paper,#f4efe4);font:600 .72rem var(--display,system-ui);letter-spacing:.055em;text-transform:uppercase}
.rc2ModuleTools button:hover,.rc2FlowPrefs:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.rc2ModuleTools .rc2ModePill{margin-right:auto;color:var(--gold,#cab78b);border-color:rgba(202,183,139,.34);background:rgba(202,183,139,.06);cursor:default}
.rc2SheetBackdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10050;background:rgba(1,8,15,.78);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;padding:18px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.rc2Sheet{width:min(100%,680px);max-height:min(86vh,820px);overflow:auto;border:1px solid rgba(197,209,218,.22);border-radius:22px 22px 16px 16px;background:#0b2034;color:#edf1f3;box-shadow:0 28px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.rc2Sheet header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:18px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(197,209,218,.17);background:rgba(11,32,52,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.rc2Sheet header small{display:block;color:#cab78b;font:600 .65rem var(--display,system-ui);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px}.rc2Sheet header strong{font-size:1.22rem}.rc2SheetClose{width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid rgba(197,209,218,.22);border-radius:50%;background:transparent;color:#edf1f3;font-size:1.25rem}
.rc2SheetBody{padding:20px}.rc2SheetIntro{color:#bdc9d1;line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 18px}.rc2GuideSection,.rc2PrefSection{margin:0 0 14px;padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(197,209,218,.17);border-radius:15px;background:rgba(16,47,76,.48)}
.rc2GuideSection h3,.rc2PrefSection h3{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:1.02rem}.rc2GuideSection p,.rc2PrefSection p{margin:0;color:#cbd5dc;line-height:1.55}.rc2GuideSection a{color:#eadbb8}
.rc2SourceLinks{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}.rc2SourceLinks a{display:inline-flex;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid rgba(202,183,139,.28);border-radius:999px;color:#eadbb8;text-decoration:none;font-size:.78rem}
.rc2Segments{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;margin-top:10px}.rc2Segments.three{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.rc2Segments button{min-height:44px;border:1px solid rgba(197,209,218,.22);border-radius:11px;background:#07192c;color:#cbd5dc;padding:8px}.rc2Segments button.active{background:#d9e1e6;color:#152b3e;border-color:#e8edf0;font-weight:700}
.rc2Toggle{display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:start;padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(197,209,218,.13)}.rc2Toggle:first-of-type{border-top:0}.rc2Toggle input{width:18px;height:18px;margin-top:2px}.rc2Toggle strong{display:block}.rc2Toggle span span{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#9fb0bc;font-size:.83rem;line-height:1.4}
.rc2Module.rc2-no-scripture .lab-scripture-cue,.rc2Module.rc2-no-scripture [data-ao-r-context]{display:none!important}.rc2Module.rc2-no-commentary [data-ao-r-commentary],.rc2Module.rc2-no-commentary .lab-contemplation .commentary{display:none!important}
.rc2Module[data-rc2-module="rosary"] .lab-option-bar label{display:none}
.rc2Module[data-rc2-module="angelus"] .lab-practice-sheet>label.lab-practice-note{display:none}
.flowTop{gap:10px}.flowTop .rc2FlowPrefs{flex:0 0 auto}.flowTop>button[data-prepare-guide],.flowTop>button[data-thanks-guide]{margin-left:auto}.flowTop .rc2FlowPrefs{margin-left:-4px}
.rc2FlowNote{font-size:.84rem;color:#9fb0bc;margin-top:8px}
@media(max-width:560px){.rc2ModuleTools{justify-content:stretch}.rc2ModuleTools button{flex:1}.rc2ModuleTools .rc2ModePill{flex:1 0 100%;margin-right:0}.rc2SheetBackdrop{padding:0;align-items:flex-end}.rc2Sheet{border-radius:20px 20px 0 0;max-height:91vh}.rc2Segments.three{grid-template-columns:1fr}.flowTop .rc2FlowPrefs{padding-inline:8px;font-size:.66rem}}
</style>

<style id="ao-v411-rule-css">
.aoRuleCardV411{
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr;
  gap:0;
  margin:10px 16px 14px;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 60%,var(--border));
  border-radius:16px;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 10%,transparent),transparent 46%),
    color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface-1) 92%,transparent);
  box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.24),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04);
}
.aoRuleCardV411::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:3px;background:var(--liturgical);z-index:2
}
.aoRuleCardV411.hasHero{grid-template-columns:76px minmax(0,1fr)}
.aoRuleBody{min-width:0;padding:10px 11px 11px}
.aoRuleHero{
  position:relative;min-height:88px;border:0;border-right:1px solid var(--border);
  padding:0;background:var(--surface-2);overflow:hidden;color:var(--text)
}
.aoRuleHero img{
  position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;opacity:.78;filter:saturate(.82) contrast(1.04)
}
.aoRuleHero::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 36%,rgba(3,8,14,.78))
}
.aoRuleHero span{
  position:absolute;z-index:1;left:6px;right:6px;bottom:6px;
  font:600 .52rem/1.15 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;
  text-align:left;color:#f3eee3;text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.7)
}
.aoRuleHead{
  display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:space-between!important;
  min-height:22px!important;margin:0 0 6px!important
}
.aoRuleTitle{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--text);font:600 .72rem/1.15 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase
}
.aoRuleTitle>span{color:var(--liturgical)}
.aoRuleCount{
  padding:2px 6px!important;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 28%,var(--border))!important;
  border-radius:999px!important;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 5%,transparent)!important;
  color:var(--muted)!important;font-size:.62rem!important
}
.aoRuleNow{
  display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 28px!important;
  align-items:center!important;gap:4px!important;
  margin:0 0 7px!important;padding:0!important;border:0!important;background:transparent!important
}
.aoRuleNowMain{
  width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:35px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:baseline;gap:7px;
  border:0;border-left:3px solid var(--liturgical);border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;
  padding:6px 8px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 7%,transparent);
  color:var(--text);text-align:left
}
.aoRuleNowMain small{
  color:var(--liturgical);font:600 .55rem/1 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase
}
.aoRuleNowMain strong{
  min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;
  font:600 .9rem/1.12 var(--font-liturgical)
}
.aoRuleNowMain>span{
  color:var(--liturgical);font:700 .56rem/1 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap
}
.aoRuleNowDone{
  width:27px;height:27px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:50%;
  background:transparent;color:var(--muted);padding:0;font-size:.78rem
}
.aoRuleStatic{
  display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:5px!important;flex-wrap:nowrap!important;
  min-height:28px!important;overflow-x:auto!important;padding:0!important;scrollbar-width:none!important
}
.aoRuleStatic::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.aoRulePill{
  flex:0 0 auto!important;display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;
  min-height:27px!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11)!important;border-radius:999px!important;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.026)!important;overflow:hidden!important
}
.aoRulePill.done{
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 8%,transparent)!important;
  border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 36%,var(--border))!important
}
.aoRuleCheck{
  width:25px!important;min-height:25px!important;padding:0!important;border:0!important;
  background:transparent!important;color:var(--liturgical)!important
}
.aoRuleOpen{
  min-height:25px!important;padding:3px 8px 3px 0!important;border:0!important;
  background:transparent!important;color:var(--text)!important;font-size:.68rem!important;white-space:nowrap!important
}
.aoRulePill.done .aoRuleOpen{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) 72%,var(--muted))!important}

/* inherited v40 elements no longer used on the compact card */
.aoRuleTodayLabel,.aoRuleComplete,.aoRuleMore{display:none!important}

/* concise Rule sheet */
.aoRuleV411SheetItem{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 34px;gap:8px;align-items:center;
  padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.055)
}
.aoRuleV411SheetItem:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.aoRuleV411SheetItem>button:first-child{
  border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--text);text-align:left;padding:5px 0
}
.aoRuleV411SheetItem strong{display:block;font-size:.88rem}
.aoRuleV411SheetItem span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.68rem;margin-top:2px}
.aoRuleV411SheetItem .mark{
  width:30px;height:30px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:50%;
  background:transparent;color:var(--liturgical)
}
.aoRuleV411SheetItem .mark.done{background:var(--liturgical-soft);border-color:var(--liturgical-border)}

@media(max-width:430px){
 .aoRuleCardV411{margin:8px 16px 12px}
 .aoRuleCardV411.hasHero{grid-template-columns:70px minmax(0,1fr)}
 .aoRuleBody{padding:9px 9px 10px}
 .aoRuleHero{min-height:84px}
 .aoRuleNowMain{grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:6px}
 .aoRuleNowMain>span{display:none}
}
</style>


<style id="ao-v412-rule-hero-card-css">
.aoRuleHomeV412{

  background:linear-gradient(145deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 7%,var(--surface-1)),var(--surface-1))!important;
  box-shadow:0 12px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.16)!important
}

}
.aoRuleCardHeader{

  margin-bottom:11px
}
.aoRuleHeaderCopy{min-width:0}
.aoRuleHeaderCopy b{

}
.aoRuleCardHeader .roundAction{

}
.aoRuleModuleGrid{

}
.aoRuleModule{

  background:var(--surface-1);overflow:hidden
}

  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--liturgical-soft),var(--surface-1))
}

}

}
.aoRuleModuleHero img{

  filter:saturate(.88) contrast(1.04)
}
.aoRuleHeroShade{

  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,5,9,.04),rgba(2,5,9,.24))
}
.aoRuleModuleHeroFallback{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--liturgical-soft),var(--surface-2))
}
.aoRuleHeroMonogram{font-size:1.65rem;color:var(--liturgical);opacity:.85}
.aoRuleModuleCopy{
  min-width:0;padding:10px 11px 11px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start
}
.aoRuleModule.wide .aoRuleModuleCopy{
  justify-content:center;padding:14px 15px
}
.aoRuleModuleCopy small{
  color:var(--liturgical);
  font:650 .57rem/1.1 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase
}
.aoRuleModuleCopy strong{
  display:block;margin-top:5px;
  font:600 .95rem/1.18 var(--font-display);
  overflow-wrap:anywhere
}
.aoRuleModule.wide .aoRuleModuleCopy strong{font-size:1.1rem}
.aoRuleModuleCopy>span:last-child{
  margin-top:auto;padding-top:8px;color:var(--liturgical);
  font:650 .62rem/1 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase
}
.aoRuleModuleCheck{
  position:absolute;z-index:3;right:8px;top:8px;
  width:30px;height:30px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.32);border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(5,9,14,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
  color:#f1eee6;font-size:.82rem;padding:0
}
.aoRuleModule.done .aoRuleModuleCheck{
  border-color:var(--liturgical);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 75%,#10151d);color:#080b0e
}
.aoRuleModule.done .aoRuleModuleHero img{opacity:.68}
.aoRuleModule.done .aoRuleModuleCopy strong{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) 74%,var(--muted))}
.aoRuleCardFoot{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:430px){
 .aoRuleHomeV412{padding:13px 14px!important}
 .aoRuleModuleGrid{gap:8px}
 .aoRuleModuleLaunch{min-height:144px;grid-template-rows:80px minmax(64px,auto)}
 .aoRuleModule.wide .aoRuleModuleLaunch{
   min-height:112px;grid-template-columns:40% minmax(0,1fr);grid-template-rows:112px
 }
 .aoRuleModuleCopy{padding:9px 9px 10px}
 .aoRuleModule.wide .aoRuleModuleCopy{padding:12px 13px}
 .aoRuleModuleCopy strong{font-size:.9rem}
 .aoRuleModule.wide .aoRuleModuleCopy strong{font-size:1.04rem}

}
</style>


<style id="ao-v413-scripture-language-css">
.v38ScripturePair,.v383ScripturePair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px}

.v38ScriptureLang,.v383ScriptureLang,.ao-r-context-lang{font:600 .67rem/1.25 var(--display,serif);letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold,#c7ae6d);margin:0 0 8px}
.v38RiteText{margin:12px 0 18px}.v38RiteText>h3{margin:0 0 10px}.v38RiteBody{white-space:pre-line;line-height:1.62}
.v383Historical{margin-top:14px}.v383Historical>summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}.v383ScriptureRef{font-weight:700;margin:0 0 8px}

<style id="ao-v4311-stations-sacred-art-css">
/* v43.11 — Stations sacred-art integration. Native Ad Orientem tokens only. */
#aoPrayerBookRoot .aoV4311StationsArt{
  margin:0 0 14px;border:1px solid var(--liturgical-border);border-radius:var(--radius-m);
  overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface-1);box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.18)
}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .aoV4311StationsArt img{
  display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:min(58vh,590px);object-fit:contain;background:#05080c
}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .aoV4311StationsArt figcaption{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface-1);color:var(--text);
  font:600 .76rem/1.35 var(--font-display)
}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .aoV4311StationsArt figcaption span:last-child{
  color:var(--muted);font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap
}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .aoV4311StationsArt.is-subtle img{filter:saturate(.78) brightness(.72);opacity:.86}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .aoV4311StationsLandingArt{margin:0 0 16px}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-hero .aoV4311StationsLandingArt img{max-height:min(46vh,470px)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-hero .aoV4311StationsLandingArt figcaption{background:rgba(7,18,29,.86)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-hero .aoV4311StationsLandingArt figcaption span:first-child{color:var(--paper)}
#aoPrayerBookRoot .lab-stations-hero .aoV4311StationsLandingArt figcaption span:last-child{color:var(--muted)}
#rc2-module-sheet .aoV4311StationsArtPref .rc2Segments{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
@media(max-width:560px){
 #aoPrayerBookRoot .aoV4311StationsArt img{max-height:50vh}
 #aoPrayerBookRoot .aoV4311StationsArt figcaption{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
 #aoPrayerBookRoot .aoV4311StationsArt figcaption span:last-child{white-space:normal}
}
</style>
<style id="ao-v4312-cinematic-loading-css">
/* v43.12 — observer-free presentation-only cinematic/loading layer. No liturgical/data/navigation ownership. */
#ao-cinema-boot,#ao-cinema-transition,#ao-cinema-loader{font-family:var(--font-liturgical);color:var(--text);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
#ao-cinema-boot{position:fixed;z-index:2147483000;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 34%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 16%,transparent),transparent 26rem),linear-gradient(180deg,#0c1118 0%,#070a0f 72%,#05070a 100%);opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .62s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1),visibility 0s linear .62s}
#ao-cinema-boot.aoCinemaBootDone{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.aoCinemaBootAtmosphere{position:absolute;inset:-12%;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 22%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 12%,transparent),transparent 36%),linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 47%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 4%,transparent) 50%,transparent 53%);filter:blur(10px);animation:aoCinemaBreathe 4.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.aoCinemaBootInner{position:relative;width:min(84vw,390px);padding:26px 22px;text-align:center}
.aoCinemaBootCross{display:grid;place-items:center;width:60px;height:60px;margin:0 auto 20px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 48%,rgba(255,255,255,.16));border-radius:50%;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 7%,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 2%,transparent),0 0 44px color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 15%,transparent);color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 76%,#efe9dd);font:500 1.65rem/1 var(--font-display);animation:aoCinemaCross 2.7s ease-in-out infinite}
.aoCinemaBootKicker{color:var(--liturgical);font:600 .61rem/1 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase}
.aoCinemaBootTitle{margin:10px 0 5px;font:600 clamp(1.6rem,7vw,2.15rem)/1.08 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.085em;text-transform:uppercase;text-wrap:balance}
.aoCinemaBootSub{color:var(--muted);font-size:.86rem;letter-spacing:.035em}
.aoCinemaBootRule{position:relative;width:min(250px,70vw);height:1px;margin:24px auto 14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);overflow:hidden}
.aoCinemaBootRule i{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 -45%;width:45%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--liturgical),transparent);box-shadow:0 0 16px var(--liturgical);animation:aoCinemaSweep 1.65s ease-in-out infinite}
.aoCinemaBootStatus{min-height:1.3em;color:var(--muted-2);font-size:.75rem;letter-spacing:.035em;transition:opacity .2s ease}
.aoCinemaBootStatus.ready{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 74%,var(--text))}
@keyframes aoCinemaSweep{0%{transform:translateX(0);opacity:.15}45%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translateX(320%);opacity:.15}}
@keyframes aoCinemaBreathe{to{transform:scale(1.045);opacity:.76}}
@keyframes aoCinemaCross{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 2%,transparent),0 0 34px color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 10%,transparent)}50%{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 3%,transparent),0 0 52px color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 18%,transparent)}}

#ao-cinema-transition{position:fixed;z-index:2147482900;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 48%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 13%,transparent),transparent 24rem),rgba(5,8,12,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(13px);transition:opacity .18s ease,visibility 0s linear .2s}
#ao-cinema-transition.aoCinemaTransitionOn{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .11s ease}
#ao-cinema-transition.aoCinemaTransitionOut{opacity:0;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .48s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1)}
.aoCinemaTransitionInner{text-align:center;padding:28px 24px;transform:translateY(5px);opacity:.76;transition:transform .46s cubic-bezier(.18,.8,.2,1),opacity .42s ease}
.aoCinemaTransitionOn .aoCinemaTransitionInner{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}
.aoCinemaTransitionGlyph{display:block;margin-bottom:13px;color:var(--liturgical);font:500 1.1rem/1 var(--font-display);text-shadow:0 0 22px color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 42%,transparent)}
.aoCinemaTransitionKicker{display:block;color:var(--liturgical);font:600 .56rem/1 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.19em;text-transform:uppercase}
.aoCinemaTransitionTitle{display:block;margin-top:9px;font:600 clamp(1.1rem,5vw,1.45rem)/1.15 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.04em;text-wrap:balance}
.aoCinemaTransitionLine{display:block;width:96px;height:1px;margin:17px auto 0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--liturgical),transparent);transform:scaleX(.15);opacity:.3;transition:transform .48s .02s ease,opacity .3s ease}
.aoCinemaTransitionOn .aoCinemaTransitionLine{transform:scaleX(1);opacity:.8}

#ao-cinema-loader{position:fixed;z-index:2147482800;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:22px;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;background:rgba(5,8,12,.64);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);transition:opacity .24s ease,visibility 0s linear .25s}
#ao-cinema-loader.aoCinemaLoaderOn{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .18s ease}
.aoCinemaLoaderCard{width:min(88vw,360px);padding:20px 19px 18px;border:1px solid var(--liturgical-border);border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface-2) 94%,transparent),rgba(9,13,19,.96));box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.34)}
.aoCinemaLoaderHead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin-bottom:16px}.aoCinemaLoaderMark{width:30px;height:30px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--liturgical-border);border-radius:50%;color:var(--liturgical);font-size:.82rem}.aoCinemaLoaderText{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}.aoCinemaLoaderText b{font:600 .8rem/1.2 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.025em}.aoCinemaLoaderText small{color:var(--muted-2);font-size:.7rem}
.aoCinemaSkeleton{display:grid;gap:9px}.aoCinemaSkeleton i{display:block;height:8px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.045) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.1) 45%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 17%,rgba(255,255,255,.07)) 52%,rgba(255,255,255,.045) 100%);background-size:240% 100%;animation:aoCinemaSkeleton 1.35s linear infinite}.aoCinemaSkeleton i:nth-child(1){width:76%}.aoCinemaSkeleton i:nth-child(2){width:94%}.aoCinemaSkeleton i:nth-child(3){width:62%}
@keyframes aoCinemaSkeleton{to{background-position:-140% 0}}

#app.aoCinemaSceneEnter>.homeScreen,#app.aoCinemaSceneEnter>.liveScreen,#app.aoCinemaSceneEnter>.flowScreen,#app.aoCinemaSceneEnter>.scriptureScreen{animation:aoCinemaSceneIn .52s cubic-bezier(.18,.8,.2,1) both}
@keyframes aoCinemaSceneIn{from{opacity:.25;transform:translateY(8px) scale(.996);filter:blur(2px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}}
.aoCinemaSurfaceIn{animation:aoCinemaSurfaceIn .42s cubic-bezier(.18,.8,.2,1) both}
@keyframes aoCinemaSurfaceIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px) scale(.992)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

.aoCinemaArt{background:linear-gradient(110deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035),rgba(255,255,255,.075),rgba(255,255,255,.035));background-size:220% 100%;animation:aoCinemaArtShimmer 1.5s linear infinite;overflow:hidden}
.aoCinemaArt img{will-change:filter,opacity,transform;transition:filter .72s cubic-bezier(.18,.8,.2,1),opacity .58s ease,transform 1.05s cubic-bezier(.18,.8,.2,1)}
.aoCinemaArt img.aoCinemaImagePending{filter:blur(15px);opacity:.28;transform:scale(1.028)}
.aoCinemaArt img.aoCinemaImageReady{filter:none;opacity:1;transform:none}
.aoCinemaArt img.aoCinemaImageError{filter:none;opacity:.18;transform:none}
@keyframes aoCinemaArtShimmer{to{background-position:-120% 0}}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 #ao-cinema-boot,#ao-cinema-transition,#ao-cinema-loader,.aoCinemaTransitionInner,.aoCinemaTransitionLine,#app.aoCinemaSceneEnter>.homeScreen,#app.aoCinemaSceneEnter>.liveScreen,#app.aoCinemaSceneEnter>.flowScreen,#app.aoCinemaSceneEnter>.scriptureScreen,.aoCinemaSurfaceIn,.aoCinemaArt img{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;transform:none!important;filter:none!important}
 .aoCinemaBootAtmosphere,.aoCinemaBootCross,.aoCinemaBootRule i,.aoCinemaSkeleton i{animation:none!important}
}
html[data-reduced-motion="true"] #ao-cinema-transition,html[data-reduced-motion="true"] #ao-cinema-loader{backdrop-filter:none}
</style>

<style id="ao-v43-16-logo-integration">
/* v43.16 — Ad Orientem identity mark integration. Presentation only. */
.brandRow {
  grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0,1fr) auto;
  gap: 10px;
}
.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem {
  width: 46px;
  height: 46px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--liturgical);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  overflow: visible;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before {
  content: "";
  display: block;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  background: currentColor;
  -webkit-mask-image: url("data:image/png;base64,");
  mask-image: url("data:image/png;base64,");
  -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat;
  mask-repeat: no-repeat;
  -webkit-mask-position: center;
  mask-position: center;
  -webkit-mask-size: contain;
  mask-size: contain;
}
@media (max-width: 350px) {
  .brandRow { grid-template-columns: 44px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 8px; }
  .brandMark.aoBrandEmblem { width: 42px; height: 42px; }
  .brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before { width: 40px; height: 40px; }
}
@media (prefers-contrast: more) {
  .brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before {
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 0.35px currentColor);
  }
}
</style>

<style id="ao-v43-17-brand-presence">
/* v43.17 — brand presence in home, cinematics and install surfaces. Presentation only. */
.brandRow{grid-template-columns:60px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:11px;min-height:62px}
.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem{width:58px;height:58px}
.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before{width:56px;height:56px}

/* Cinematic boot: the app emblem replaces the generic cross glyph. */
.aoCinemaBootCross.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem{
  width:112px;height:112px;margin:0 auto 18px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;
  color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 78%,#efe9dd);
  box-shadow:none;overflow:visible;
}
.aoCinemaBootCross.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before{
  width:106px;height:106px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 24px color-mix(in srgb,var(--liturgical) 24%,transparent));
}

/* Route-change cinematic: compact branded emblem. */
.aoCinemaTransitionGlyph.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem{
  width:48px;height:48px;margin:0 auto 13px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--liturgical);box-shadow:none;
}
.aoCinemaTransitionGlyph.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before{width:46px;height:46px}

/* Async-content loader: smaller but still recognisably the same mark. */
.aoCinemaLoaderMark.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem{
  width:32px;height:32px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--liturgical);box-shadow:none;flex:0 0 32px;
}
.aoCinemaLoaderMark.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before{width:30px;height:30px}

@media(max-width:520px){
  .brandRow{grid-template-columns:56px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:9px;min-height:58px}
  .brandMark.aoBrandEmblem{width:54px;height:54px}
  .brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before{width:52px;height:52px}
  .aoCinemaBootCross.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem{width:100px;height:100px}
  .aoCinemaBootCross.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before{width:94px;height:94px}
  .aoCinemaTransitionGlyph.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem{width:44px;height:44px}
  .aoCinemaTransitionGlyph.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before{width:42px;height:42px}
  .aoCinemaLoaderMark.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem{width:30px;height:30px;flex-basis:30px}
  .aoCinemaLoaderMark.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before{width:28px;height:28px}
}
@media(max-width:350px){
  .brandRow{grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:8px;min-height:54px}
  .brandMark.aoBrandEmblem{width:50px;height:50px}
  .brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before{width:48px;height:48px}
  .aoCinemaBootCross.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem{width:88px;height:88px}
  .aoCinemaBootCross.brandMark.aoBrandEmblem::before{width:84px;height:84px}
}
</style>
<script id="ao-v43-22-date-policy">
(()=>{'use strict';
 const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
 function format(value){
   if(value==null||value==='')return '';
   if(value instanceof Date&&!Number.isNaN(value.getTime()))return `${pad(value.getDate())}/${pad(value.getMonth()+1)}/${value.getFullYear()}`;
   const raw=String(value).trim();
   const iso=raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})(?:$|T)/);
   if(iso)return `${iso[3]}/${iso[2]}/${iso[1]}`;
   const d=new Date(value);
   if(!Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))return `${pad(d.getDate())}/${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}/${d.getFullYear()}`;
   return raw;
 }
 globalThis.AO_DISPLAY_DATE=format;
})();
</script>
</head><body>

</div>

<style id="ao-phase1-proper-art-v1-css">

.aoProperArt{margin:14px 0 2px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 16%,transparent);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(12,11,10,.94);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.14)}
.aoProperArtMedia{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:150px;max-height:330px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.24)}
.aoProperArt img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:330px;object-fit:contain;object-position:center;opacity:.98}
.aoProperArt.isPortrait .aoProperArtMedia,.aoProperArt.isPortrait img{max-height:min(440px,52vh)}
.aoProperArt.isLandscape .aoProperArtMedia,.aoProperArt.isLandscape img{max-height:300px}
.aoProperArt figcaption{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;padding:9px 12px 10px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;opacity:.86}
.aoProperArt figcaption span{min-width:0}.aoProperArt figcaption strong{font-weight:700}.aoProperArt figcaption a{white-space:nowrap;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor}
@media(max-width:560px){.aoProperArt{margin-top:12px;border-radius:15px}.aoProperArtMedia,.aoProperArt img{max-height:280px}.aoProperArt.isPortrait .aoProperArtMedia,.aoProperArt.isPortrait img{max-height:min(390px,49vh)}.aoProperArt.isLandscape .aoProperArtMedia,.aoProperArt.isLandscape img{max-height:250px}.aoProperArt figcaption{font-size:10px}}

</style>

const esc=v=>String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#039;'}[c]));
const normPath=raw=>{let p=String(raw||'').trim().replace(/\\/g,'/').replace(/^\.?\//,'').replace(/\.(txt|json|html)$/i,'');p=p.replace(/^tempora:/i,'Tempora/').replace(/^sancti:/i,'Sancti/');return p;};
const properPath=state=>normPath(state?.resolution?.proper?.status==='ready'?(state.resolution.proper.data?.sourcePath||state.resolution.proper.data?.path):(state?.resolution?.day?.main?.path||''));
const thumb=(file,width)=>file?`https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:Redirect/file/${encodeURIComponent(file)}?width=${width}`:'';
const sourceLabel=lang=>lang==='fr'?'Source':'Source';
function homeMarkup(state,lang='en'){
 const path=properPath(state),r=DATA.rows[path];
 if(!r||r.status!=='GREEN'||!r.primaryArtId)return '';
 const a=DATA.artworks[r.primaryArtId];if(!a||!a.file||!a.sourcePage)return '';
 const license=a.license||a.rights||'';
 const attribution=a.attribution||'';
 const attr=attribution&&/^CC BY/i.test(license)&&!attribution.toLowerCase().includes('cc by')?`${attribution} · ${license}`:(attribution||license);
 const alt=`${a.artist||''} — ${a.title||r.label||''}`;
 const ratio=(Number(a.width)||1)/(Number(a.height)||1);
 const orientation=ratio<0.82?'isPortrait':ratio>1.22?'isLandscape':'isBalanced';
 const src=thumb(a.file,1280),s800=thumb(a.file,768),s1800=thumb(a.file,1800);
 return `<figure class="aoProperArt ${orientation}" data-ao-proper-art="${esc(r.primaryArtId)}" data-proper-path="${esc(path)}"><div class="aoProperArtMedia"><img src="${esc(src)}" srcset="${esc(s800)} 768w, ${esc(src)} 1280w, ${esc(s1800)} 1800w" sizes="(max-width:560px) 100vw, 720px" alt="${esc(alt)}" loading="eager" fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" onerror="this.closest('figure')?.remove()"></div><figcaption><span><strong>${esc(a.artist||'')}</strong>${a.title?` · ${esc(a.title)}`:''}${attr?`<br><small>${esc(attr)}</small>`:''}</span><a href="${esc(a.sourcePage)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${sourceLabel(lang)} ↗</a></figcaption></figure>`;
}
